g.text: MarieRank5Convo5 begins.
Check boolean MarieDating
Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have to tell you the silliest thing.
true
Bonjour ! I have to tell you the silliest thing.
false
Oh? What happened?
[Koniec]
I asked M'sieur Bird Trois what his birthday was, and he did not know ! How terribly sad !
Chat ends.
None of the Cavia know their birthdays, which I suppose makes sense, given that they were born without the ability to speak or know the calendrier as we do.
So I thought, what a tragédie ! We must right this at once, non ?
I never thought about that.
How will you discover when they were born?
Will you let them pick their birthdays?
Oui ! Neither had Monsieur Loid. The look on his face when I discovered this was of pure sorrow...
At first, I thought to check le Cardinal's records - perhaps he recorded when they were born, oui ?
"Let ?" You say it as if it is up to me !
It breaks my heart that he thinks it is his fault for not thinking of it first. It is not his fault, he does so much for so many...
Evaluate expressions
We are all blessed to know the kindness of Monsieur Loid. The depth of the well he draws from knows no end.
But then I remembered... my conversations with M'sieur Tagfer, and the others, and I thought... that may not be so wise.
MarieEntratiComplete
MarieEntrati3a
But they seemed uninterested in finding records of their past. I know how painful it can be, to think of one's origins.
false
We really are lucky he's here.
I just wish he'd cheer up a bit from time to time.
I do not know my own day of birth, after all.
Oui, that we are. That we all are.
He is a serious man, but I have seen him smile. There is humor in him, when one least expects it. One just has to be patient.
If it makes you feel any better, neither do I. I suspect the kid doesn't remember, either.
Birthdays are overrated.
It's more fun to pick your own, anyway. More poignant.
Check boolean MarieDating
More reasons to weep for you and your minuscule copie. Yet more things we have in common !
I do not believe they are overrated at all ! We must celebrate those that are still with us, the same that we celebrate those who are gone.
Poignant ? I did not know you spoke any Gaullique ! Did you pick that up from me ?
+20 Chemistry
true
+20 Chemistry
false
I... think it's just the same in both languages...
I must have picked it up from you.
Now ! Come along, mon cœur ! Even if nothing ever comes of this, it is always the thought that counts ! Au calendrier !
Now ! Come along ! Even if nothing ever comes of this, it is the thought that counts ! Au calendrier !
Pff ! All the other languages are always stealing the best parts of Gaullique and running away with it ! Times will never change !
Then you are smart ! Gaullique is one of the most beautiful languages to ever be, and I am glad to bring it to this futur.
Chat ends.
